ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-style crust with pale golden-tan edge, covered in melted white cheese with slight browning and bubbling; a round, dark red-orange slice sits at its base edge with a glossy, slightly oily sheen; piece about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, lying on upper right of plate, roughly 6% of plate area, about 1.5 cm thick at the crust | 75

ITEM 2 | Irregular piece of breaded, pan-fried meat with a golden-brown crisp exterior, darker browned speckles and edges, paler interior crumb showing through a torn spot; slightly dry matte surface with no visible sauce; piece about 5 cm by 4 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, with a small thin tail-like flap, sitting alone on the right side of the plate | 60
